title: done's ledger check reports an _anchors.csv row an item added and a later commit dropped as added
goal: ledger_change returns ['added'] for an _anchors.csv row absent both at the first parent and at HEAD (b and a both None, b is None tested first), so ledger_moves names a row an item's commit added and a later commit dropped though its net change is nothing, against its docstring's 'a later revert clears it' (SP-ia6xayiy review, S2, from BG-ph7dcjhz's per-commit rewrite): a row absent at both ends counts no change
